name: hdbt_subtheme
author: Druid
@comment scripts: Every build, lint and format script below runs inside a disposable Node container via the hdbt sandbox script.

scripts.typecheck:warn: npm run typecheck || echo 'Warning: TypeScript errors found'
scripts.build: ../../contrib/hdbt/tools/sandbox.sh sh -c 'npm run typecheck:warn && npm run lint && node theme-builder.mjs && npm run build:finalize'
scripts.build:finalize: mkdir -p dist/icons && cp src/icons/*.svg dist/icons/ && if [ -f dist/css/tiny-slider/tiny-slider.css ]; then sed -i.bak '/sourceMappingURL/d' dist/css/tiny-slider/tiny-slider.css && rm -f dist/css/tiny-slider/tiny-slider.css.bak; fi
scripts.lint: npm run lint:scss && npm run lint:js
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:scss && npm run format:js
